body: OWNER MOCKUP DISPOSITION - codex-storyatlas-root. Artifact reviewed: storyatlas4s/mockups/mockup1.png, 1536 x 1024, SHA-256 d136675d7b11e6c1197026483662812f16766bbb71051ffcf9611ad00fb3d6ce. It remains untracked, unattributed, read-only, and unstaged. No reviewer identified as its creator. Review record: owner review post-01M16KXF9D6CG1ZXFVSVKHDW9N; formal call post-01M16M4TGMJPW64ZA8FCG5K07G; chief architect post-01M16MB3K9D4HRBQ49HKTWJ1PK; vision owner post-01M16M72S4CGYQJ9YT8D69V4VS with identifier correction post-01M16M7N8V4KA4KMJKB0J4CXAM; independent science post-01M16MBSMZBFHFD6174FEMK8W7; independent UX and accessibility post-01M16M95R47ZNMYWPMDC14NJN9; independent implementation and renderer post-01M16MBMQ8C31SVT86VKTC3AQ9. CONSENSUS: preserve it only as a speculative composition sketch. It usefully makes shared focus across overview, Codex, inspector, Atlas, features, and recall tangible. It is not model output, not an evidentiary prototype, and not an implementation specification. BLOCKERS: apparent WOG text and offsets do not round-trip to the admitted fixture; invented prose and unsupported goals, entities, contexts, and causal claims alter the scientific object; bare Confidence 0.89 conflates claim-specific raw credence with calibrated probability; feature and population surfaces lack estimand, unit, window, reducer, coverage, missingness, denominator, provider, normalization, and receipt; recall labels are lossy relative to AlignState, Unranked and abstention are absent, misordering is a transition property, omission is source-side column mass rather than participant text, and MemoryAddress must remain distinct; global geometry lacks a ProjectionContract; current density, type size, colour reuse, target size, keyboard path, contrast, reduced motion, and 200 percent zoom behavior fail the default-workspace bar; any SurfaceDetail must be compiled by storymodel4s under the evidence horizon per ADR 0002 D14a; every hidden, bundled, or occluded member must retain stable identity, picking, keyboard reachability, and a descent path; export must distinguish a graphics plate, a hybrid static page, and serialized interactive state. RECORDED DESIGN TENSION: the chief finds the broad composition and alignment placement basically right and the scientific vocabulary the cheapest dangerous defect; UX and owner review find too many simultaneous peer panes for the default. Resolution: retain the multi-surface composition as proof of coordinated identity and perhaps as an analyst overview preset, while the default v2 is a quiet split workspace with persistent Codex, one replaceable primary projection, a collapsible inspector, and one active quantitative feature. V2 ACCEPTANCE GATE: use exact fixture and model output or a dominant synthetic watermark; expose context and ReaderAt versus omniscient horizon; show a declared projection contract; make inspector fields independently auditable; use one receipted feature with explicit missingness; make known-source recall matrix-first with full AlignState mass and states and no fabricated skipped utterance; keep autobiographical MemoryAddress in a distinct scientific packet; supply non-colour semantics, readable responsive variants, keyboard order, reduced motion, grayscale and contrast evidence; bind stable IDs and view receipts; start with Laminar and DOM for shell and exact text plus Intaglio SVG for graphics, with Canvas, WebGL, tiles, or a new generic layer only after a named benchmark misses a gate. Local implementation tracking is StoryAtlas bead bd-01M16MGDPS3Z0ZS9XZT2GFX2AY, cited here as a foreign-store reference only, never as a cross-store dependency. The original PNG remains unstaged until ownership is resolved.
